_comment: The three followers' standard lines (drafting/followers_standard_approved.json), in staff_dialogue.json's shape, with their own voice types. npcgen builds them in an ID block of their own (0x1900-, merged 0x9100-) only once 'live' is true or AG_FOLLOWER_VOICES=1 (the recording build): their own voice type takes them off vanilla's follower voice lists until the DLL adds the new voices, so 'live' waits for that DLL work.

AGHallResidentOrc.helloLow1: Ha! Still standing? Good. That's how it starts.
AGHallResidentOrc.helloLow2: Keep your shield up and your belly full.
AGHallResidentOrc.rankC1: You've got some weight behind you now.
AGHallResidentOrc.rankB1: You're a real fighter. Malacath respects that.
AGHallResidentOrc.rankA1: Any chief would think twice before facing you.
AGHallResidentOrc.rankS1: Every stronghold in Skyrim should sing your name.
AGHallResidentOrc.anyRank2: Say it plainly. I like plain.
AGHallResidentOrc.helloNew1: No card? Then go get one. The pay's good and the food better.
AGHallResidentOrc.helloNew2: You look like you could swing an axe. Sign on.
AGHallResidentOrc.idle3: My knuckles itch. Too long since a good fight.
AGHallResidentOrc.idle6: A good fight, then a good meal. That's living.

AGHallResidentRanger.rankB1: You've caught up to me. Don't take my contracts.
AGHallResidentRanger.rankA1: You'd out-track me on a good day.
AGHallResidentRanger.rankS1: They'll sing about you. Ignore them.
AGHallResidentRanger.helloNew1: Not a member. Not my problem.
AGHallResidentRanger.helloNew2: Want paying work? Sign on. Or don't. I don't care either way.
AGHallResidentRanger.goodbye2: Remember to get paid. Adventurers don't work for free.
AGHallResidentRanger.idle6: Fresh tracks by the river. Not mine to follow.

AGHallResidentScout.helloLow1: Ah, a little one. This one knows a cave just your size.
AGHallResidentScout.helloLow2: Still all ten fingers? Good, good.
AGHallResidentScout.rankC1: Khajiit tells everyone he knew you first.
AGHallResidentScout.rankB1: This one finds the places. You empty them. Good partnership.
AGHallResidentScout.rankA1: Khajiit finds the places. You, it seems, clear them.
AGHallResidentScout.rankS1: Khajiit has found many places. You have made some of them famous.
AGHallResidentScout.helloNew1: Not Guild? This one will not tell anyone.
AGHallResidentScout.helloNew2: Sign on, and I will tell you where the good jobs are.
AGHallResidentScout.goodbye2: Go well, and come back rich.
AGHallResidentScout.idle1: There is a ruin north of here. This one has marked it.
AGHallResidentScout.idle3: Every cave has a second way out, if you look long enough.
AGHallResidentScout.idle4: The wind smells of rain. This one's tail never lies.
AGHallResidentScout.idle5: The roads were longer in Elsweyr.

_followGate: Who they follow: Guild members only, at least one rank below their own (minRank: AG_PlayerRankGlobal, 0 E .. 5 S). Vanilla's "Follow me. I need your help." stays; below the bar they answer with these instead, which name no rank. The scripted menu only: their SkyrimNet bios carry it as a preference they can be talked out of.

AGHallResidentRanger.notMember: Guild contracts pay me. You don't. Sign on, then ask again.
AGHallResidentRanger.lowRank: Not yet. You'd slow me down. Come back when the Guild trusts you with real work.

AGHallResidentOrc.notMember: My axe fights for the clan, and you're not clan yet. Join the Guild first.
AGHallResidentOrc.lowRank: By Malacath, you're keen! Too green for my fights, though. A few more jobs first.

AGHallResidentScout.notMember: Khajiit walks only with Guild friends. Join, and this one is yours to lead.
